Dark and Menacing Audi SQ7 Doesn't Even Need an RS Q7 Version to Stand Out in Any Digital Crowd
6 photos
Photo: ildar_project / Instagram
The premium Ingolstadt-based German automaker Audi recently told us why the Nuvolari costs about $300k more than a Lamborghini Temerario though it should be the other way around, and also said that even the small Audi A2 e-tron can power your home and charge all the devices laying around.
The case of the Audi Nuvolari is pretty complicated: it has Formula One-inspired active aerodynamics, a carbon fiber body, milled aluminum badges, the additional power, the new quattro predictive ride setup, and many more tiny differences that put the four-ringed sports car ahead of the Lambo model, though traditionally it’s the other way around.
They also have things helping the bottom line at the opposite end – bidirectional hardware lets the recently revived Audi A2 e-tron power just about anything, from tools and devices to your home, thanks to grid support. Apparently, sporty things are always on the agenda, as the rumor mill says the all-new RS 6 Avant will come to America , and there’s potential for the RS 5 Avant to also follow it.
But what about the deal makers? As far as many observers are concerned, the all-new third-generation Audi Q7 (together with its larger Q9 sibling) has the potential to turn the tide for Audi of America, which has been slumping badly in terms of sales as of late, despite the arrival of the all-new A5 and A6 passenger cars.
But now the Audi Q7 and Q9 are seen as the heavyweights that the Ingolstadt brand needed to swing the sales around into a positive direction: the third-generation Audi Q7 has a traditional design but with numerous enhancements and gasoline plus diesel powertrains. In fact, there’s also the sporty Audi SQ7 , which packs V8 oomph under the hood, just like the Americans love to.
The massive Audi SQ7 features the company’s 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8 now packing 591 hp and 590 lb-ft of torque or 800 Nm instead of the 2.9-liter V6, and it’s going to be a tough competitor for the BMW X5 Neue Klasse and the recently facelifted Mercedes-Benz GLE and GLE Coupe. Alas, it still has the usual understated Audi looks.
But what if you don’t want to be subtle? No worries, as the members of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators dwelling across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI will certainly take care of that. For example, Ildar, the virtual artist better known as " ildar_project " on social media, usually plays with tuned vehicles - so is anyone surprised by this new creation – all over again?
Initially, he created the Angry Orange Audi SQ7, packing a dual-tone orange and black widebody transformation, but now he’s back with a more serious option featuring a gray body and piano black details. He’s still giving the SQ7 a set of humongous black Y-spoke alloy wheels, though, so no one should think that he’s grown soft lately.
